Browser.grantPermissions.notes: Context/origin allowlists for geolocation, videoCapture (camera), audioCapture (microphone), notifications and clipboard grants; other permissions explicitly reject. Unlisted permissions are denied. Native camera and microphone capture are implemented; native permission UI is unsupported.

Browser.resetPermissions.notes: Restores canonical context permission defaults and notifies live permission observers. Native permission prompts and platform permission stores are not modeled.

Browser.setPermission.notes: Context/origin granted, denied and prompt settings for geolocation, camera, microphone, notifications and clipboard. Camera pan/tilt/zoom and other descriptors reject. Requests requiring an ungranted camera or microphone reject immediately for automation; revocation ends the corresponding local capture tracks. No simulated native permission prompt.

Emulation.setGeolocationOverride.notes: Page-owned coordinates and optional altitude, altitudeAccuracy, heading and speed; missing required coordinates emulate unavailable position. Updates live watches and survives navigation. No native location provider is connected.

Emulation.clearGeolocationOverride.notes: Removes the Page-owned provider override and updates live watches. With no native provider, permitted requests report position unavailable.

Page.setGeolocationOverride.notes: Deprecated coordinate override shares the Emulation Page-owned provider state. No native location provider is connected.

Page.clearGeolocationOverride.notes: Deprecated clear command shares the Emulation Page-owned provider state; no native provider is restored.

Audits.disable.notes: Client subscription state only; no Audits issue engine or WebMCP model-context backend. Semantic support is not claimed.

Audits.enable.notes: Client subscription state only; no Audits issue engine or WebMCP model-context backend. Semantic support is not claimed.

Browser.close.notes: Acknowledges then closes CDP server and owned Pages; embedding process lifetime is separate.

Browser.getVersion.notes: Pinned protocol and product identity; Mimic product name and virtual JS engine version identify the actual implementation.

Browser.getWindowBounds.notes: Resolves stable window IDs to canonical Page bounds within the owning BrowserContext. One modeled window per Context; new Pages begin with that Context's profile bounds. Multiple windows within a Context, minimized/maximized/fullscreen transitions and display placement are unsupported.

Browser.getWindowForTarget.notes: Resolves page and tab targets to a stable modeled window per BrowserContext. Default and isolated Contexts never share window IDs. Multiple windows within a Context are unsupported.

Browser.setWindowBounds.notes: Updates position and outer dimensions only on existing Pages in the selected window's BrowserContext, preserving independent and managed Contexts. New Pages begin with the Context's profile bounds. Non-normal states and multiple windows within one Context are unsupported.

Browser.setDownloadBehavior.notes: Per-context allow, allowAndName, deny and default policies for attachment navigation responses; completed bytes are written to the configured destination and Browser download events are emitted. Other download initiators and streaming progress are not modeled.

DOM.describeNode.notes: Canonical node IDs, metadata, attributes, children and depth traversal. Shadow piercing, whitespace modes, distributed nodes and full frontend node lifecycle are incomplete.

DOM.disable.notes: Subscription state; includeWhitespace and complete incremental mutation tracking are not implemented.

DOM.enable.notes: Subscription state; includeWhitespace and complete incremental mutation tracking are not implemented.

DOM.documentUpdated.notes: DOM-enabled sessions receive the inspected top document invalidation after canonical DOMContentLoaded; child-frame parsing does not invalidate the entire frontend tree. A refreshed getDocument projects the new canonical tree. Full frontend node remapping (document-local IDs may be reused), BFCache restoration and zero-document transitions are not modeled.

DOM.focus.notes: Canonical focus shared with trusted input/isolated worlds; full browser focusability/shadow focus is incomplete.

DOM.getAttributes.notes: Alternating canonical attribute names/values for live elements; full DOM frontend lifecycle is not modeled.

DOM.getBoxModel.notes: Same modeled rectangle/CSS edges as JS and hit testing. No complete layout/transforms/SVG quads or multiple inline fragments.

DOM.getContentQuads.notes: Same modeled rectangle/CSS edges as JS and hit testing. No complete layout/transforms/SVG quads or multiple inline fragments.

DOM.getDocument.notes: Canonical node IDs, metadata, attributes, children and depth traversal. Shadow piercing, whitespace modes, distributed nodes and full frontend node lifecycle are incomplete.

DOM.getFrameOwner.notes: Returns the canonical iframe owner node for live child frames; detached frames and complete frontend node lifecycle behavior are not modeled.

DOM.getOuterHTML.notes: Serializes live nodeId/backendNodeId; objectId and includeShadowDOM are not implemented.

DOM.querySelector.notes: Uses canonical page JavaScript selector engine and publishes matched ancestor paths before returning IDs to shallow frontend trees. Selector completeness follows that engine; full frontend node bookkeeping remains incomplete.

DOM.querySelectorAll.notes: Uses canonical page JavaScript selector engine and publishes matched ancestor paths before returning IDs to shallow frontend trees. Selector completeness follows that engine; full frontend node bookkeeping remains incomplete.

DOM.removeAttribute.notes: Mutates canonical DOM through normal realm operations. Full CDP mutation notifications/frontend bookkeeping are incomplete.

DOM.removeNode.notes: Mutates canonical DOM through normal realm operations. Full CDP mutation notifications/frontend bookkeeping are incomplete.

DOM.requestChildNodes.notes: Canonical node IDs, metadata, attributes, children and depth traversal. Shadow piercing, whitespace modes, distributed nodes and full frontend node lifecycle are incomplete.

DOM.requestNode.notes: Maps canonical nodes to realm/session handles and emits ancestor projections; complete frontend lifecycle is not verified.

DOM.resolveNode.notes: Maps canonical nodes to realm/session handles and emits ancestor projections; complete frontend lifecycle is not verified.

DOM.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded.notes: Canonical element scroll operation; optional rect and full nested layout/scrolling are not implemented.

DOM.setAttributeValue.notes: Mutates canonical DOM through normal realm operations. Full CDP mutation notifications/frontend bookkeeping are incomplete.

DOM.setChildNodes.notes: Requested child/ancestor projection; full incremental frontend DOM mutation stream is absent.

DOM.setNodeValue.notes: Mutates canonical DOM through normal realm operations. Full CDP mutation notifications/frontend bookkeeping are incomplete.

DOM.setOuterHTML.notes: Mutates canonical DOM through normal realm operations. Full CDP mutation notifications/frontend bookkeeping are incomplete.

Emulation.clearDeviceMetricsOverride.notes: Canonical viewport/device scale/screen dimensions/orientation and reset. Mobile layout, scale/position/dontSetVisibleSize are incomplete; clipping/display features/posture reject.

Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride.notes: Canonical viewport/device scale/screen dimensions/orientation and reset. Mobile layout, scale/position/dontSetVisibleSize are incomplete; clipping/display features/posture reject.

Emulation.setEmulatedMedia.notes: Screen media and canonical prefers-color-scheme/reduced-motion. forced-colors and prefers-contrast are accepted without applying an override; other media/features reject. Complete dynamic cascade/query-change events are not verified. Generated/imported profile Contexts accept a proven no-op assignment but reject identity-changing emulation.

Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled.notes: Acknowledgment only for client initialization. The enabled flag does not override document focus, active state or focus lifecycle events; focus emulation semantics are not implemented.

Emulation.setLocaleOverride.notes: Updates the default Intl locale for future navigation realms and supports reset with an empty locale. Existing realms retain their creation locale; navigator.languages and Accept-Language are deliberately unchanged. Complete ICU locale availability follows the selected JS engine.

Emulation.setTimezoneOverride.notes: Page-local IANA timezone override and empty reset affect Intl and Date observations in the current top realm and future realms. Existing child realms and workers are not refreshed.

Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled.notes: Desktop reset only: enabled=false accepted; enabled=true explicitly rejects because touch/gesture/media emulation is absent.

Emulation.setUserAgentOverride.notes: Canonical Navigator/languages/platform, User-Agent and Client Hints request projection. formFactors, full metadata validation and all Client Hints negotiation cases are incomplete.

Fetch.continueRequest.notes: Resumes/overrides URL/method/headers/body in same loader; Fetch supports per-request response interception. Auth/complete redirect semantics are unsupported.

Fetch.continueResponse.notes: Response-stage resume with status/header overrides; responsePhrase/binaryResponseHeaders and complete redirects are unsupported.

Fetch.disable.notes: Disables interception, resumes/releases pending pauses and response overrides.

Fetch.enable.notes: Shared-loader URL/resource/stage pattern matching; explicit empty list pauses nothing. Auth challenges are unsupported.

Fetch.failRequest.notes: Aborts paused requests; distinct errorReason mappings are incomplete.

Fetch.fulfillRequest.notes: Fulfills paused loader request with responseCode/headers/base64 body. responsePhrase/binaryResponseHeaders and all cookie/cache/redirect interactions are incomplete.

Fetch.getResponseBody.notes: Reads shared response-stage paused bytes; stream handles and exact invalid-stage/error text are not implemented.

Fetch.requestPaused.notes: Shared-loader request/response-stage pauses; auth and some redirect metadata are unsupported.

Input.dispatchKeyEvent.notes: Trusted text-control editing, cancellation, beforeinput/input/change, focus, selection and basic deletion/navigation keys. Enter activates links on keydown and buttons on uncancelled keypress; Space activation remains unsupported. IME/contenteditable/complex editor commands are unsupported. Cross-world listeners are grouped by world.

Input.dispatchMouseEvent.notes: Trusted mouse/pointer/click events and form/link defaults using canonical modeled boxes. Wheel/pen reject. Drag/capture/precise layout/multi-click defaults and full enter/leave semantics are incomplete.

Input.insertText.notes: Trusted text-control editing, cancellation, beforeinput/input/change, focus, selection and basic deletion/navigation keys. IME/contenteditable/complex editor commands are unsupported. Cross-world listeners are grouped by world.

Inspector.disable.notes: Per-session subscription flags only; no complete corresponding event producers/replay. Performance timeDomain is not implemented.

Inspector.enable.notes: Per-session subscription flags only; no complete corresponding event producers/replay. Performance timeDomain is not implemented.

Log.disable.notes: Per-session subscription flags only; no complete corresponding event producers/replay. Performance timeDomain is not implemented.

Log.enable.notes: Per-session subscription flags only; no complete corresponding event producers/replay. Performance timeDomain is not implemented.

Network.clearBrowserCache.notes: Clears canonical browser-context cache entries used by Page loaders; full Chrome cache topology/revalidation is not modeled.

Network.clearBrowserCookies.notes: Clears selected canonical cookie store; Storage resolves explicit/default BrowserContext.

Network.continueInterceptedRequest.notes: Resumes/overrides URL/method/headers/body in same loader; Fetch supports per-request response interception. Auth/complete redirect semantics are unsupported.

Network.deleteCookies.notes: Canonical expiry/security/SameSite/partition identity/scoped deletion; explicit Storage context. Opaque partitions reject. priority/sameParty/sourceScheme/sourcePort metadata and all invalid-cookie errors are incomplete.

Network.disable.notes: Per-session network stream; buffer sizing/durable messages/direct-socket options are not implemented.

Network.emulateNetworkConditions.notes: Offline only; latency/throughput/connection/packet-loss/queue options are not implemented.

Network.enable.notes: Per-session network stream; buffer sizing/durable messages/direct-socket options are not implemented.

Network.getAllCookies.notes: Canonical cookies; Network URL/current-frame filtering and explicit Storage BrowserContext scoping. Detailed source/priority metadata and opaque partitions are incomplete.

Network.getCookies.notes: Canonical cookies; Network URL/current-frame filtering and explicit Storage BrowserContext scoping. Detailed source/priority metadata and opaque partitions are incomplete.

Network.getResponseBody.notes: Bounded completed loader bytes; invalid UTF-8 uses base64. Streaming/eviction/redirect-body error fidelity is incomplete.

Network.loadingFailed.notes: Canonical request/response/failure, frame/loader identity and transport protocol. Initiator stacks, redirect-ID reuse, extra-info and complete timing/security/error details are incomplete.

Network.loadingFinished.notes: Canonical request/response/failure, frame/loader identity and transport protocol. Initiator stacks, redirect-ID reuse, extra-info and complete timing/security/error details are incomplete.

Network.requestIntercepted.notes: Shared-loader request/response-stage pauses; auth and some redirect metadata are unsupported.

Network.requestWillBeSent.notes: Canonical request/response/failure, frame/loader identity and transport protocol. Initiator stacks, redirect-ID reuse, extra-info and complete timing/security/error details are incomplete.

Network.responseReceived.notes: Canonical request/response/failure, frame/loader identity and transport protocol. Canonical transport connection identity projects to stable server-scoped numeric connectionId values required by the pinned wire schema. Initiator stacks, redirect-ID reuse, extra-info and complete timing/security/error details are incomplete. Numeric connection IDs project the transport connection identity; historical IDs remain allocated for the CDP server lifetime.

Network.setCacheDisabled.notes: Canonical cache policy used by shared Page resource paths.

Network.setCookie.notes: Canonical expiry/security/SameSite/partition identity/scoped deletion; explicit Storage context. Opaque partitions reject. priority/sameParty/sourceScheme/sourcePort metadata and all invalid-cookie errors are incomplete.

Network.setCookies.notes: Canonical expiry/security/SameSite/partition identity/scoped deletion; explicit Storage context. Opaque partitions reject. priority/sameParty/sourceScheme/sourcePort metadata and all invalid-cookie errors are incomplete.

Network.setExtraHTTPHeaders.notes: Canonical header overrides for document/subresources. Full forbidden-header validation and ordering nuances are incomplete.

Network.setRequestInterception.notes: Shared-loader URL/resource/stage pattern matching; explicit empty list pauses nothing. Auth challenges are unsupported.

Network.setUserAgentOverride.notes: Canonical Navigator/languages/platform, User-Agent and Client Hints request projection. formFactors, full metadata validation and all Client Hints negotiation cases are incomplete.

Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument.notes: Stored scripts precede author scripts in default/named isolated worlds. runImmediately/includeCommandLineAPI options are not implemented.

Page.bringToFront.notes: Acknowledged for clients, but native window activation and foreground-tab switching are not modeled; activation semantics are unsupported.

Page.close.notes: Closes Page asynchronously; beforeunload dialogs and handlers are not modeled.

Page.createIsolatedWorld.notes: Independent globals/wrappers share canonical DOM, forms/focus and Page event loop. Universal access grants and complete cross-world listener registration order are not implemented.

Page.disable.notes: Per-session event subscription; experimental options and complete lifecycle vocabulary are not implemented.

Page.domContentEventFired.notes: Top-frame DOMContentLoaded/load ordered before corresponding lifecycle events.

Page.enable.notes: Per-session event subscription; experimental options and complete lifecycle vocabulary are not implemented.

Page.frameAttached.notes: Canonical frame attach/commit/removal; OOPIF and every transient/error-frame state are not modeled.

Page.frameDetached.notes: Canonical frame attach/commit/removal; OOPIF and every transient/error-frame state are not modeled.

Page.frameNavigated.notes: Canonical frame attach/commit/removal including secure-context, isolation and gated-feature projections from the realm security owner. OOPIF and every transient/error-frame state are not modeled.

Page.frameStartedLoading.notes: Session-gated projection of canonical frame navigation loading intervals, beginning before main/child resource fetch or blank-document commit. OOPIF, prerender and every UI-driven transient frame state remain outside the modeled scope.

Page.frameStoppedLoading.notes: Canonical frame loading completion after document load, cancellation or navigation failure; loader ownership prevents a replaced navigation from stopping its successor. Explicit stop does not fabricate DOMContentLoaded/load. OOPIF, prerender and every UI-driven transient frame state remain outside the modeled scope.

Page.getFrameTree.notes: Canonical top/child frame hierarchy, loader/realm identity and required secureContextType/crossOriginIsolatedContextType/gatedAPIFeatures fields from the same realm security state as JavaScript. No OOPIF target graph; security policy limitations follow the canonical realm implementation.

Page.getLayoutMetrics.notes: Canonical viewport/scroll/visual viewport and modeled document bounds. No full layout; legacy device-pixel/CSS differences and multi-fragment geometry are incomplete.

Page.getNavigationHistory.notes: Canonical joint Page history and traversal. Full UI/BFCache projection and all transient history states are not verified.

Page.lifecycleEvent.notes: Frame init/commit/DOMContentLoaded/load and top-frame networkIdle/networkAlmostIdle after 500ms quiet loader activity. Not all lifecycle vocabulary/timestamps.

Page.loadEventFired.notes: Top-frame DOMContentLoaded/load ordered before corresponding lifecycle events.

Page.navigate.notes: Asynchronous top-frame navigation owned by Page, surviving debugger detachment. frameId/referrer/transition/referrerPolicy/download options and full synchronous navigation-error results are not implemented.

Page.navigateToHistoryEntry.notes: Canonical joint Page history and traversal. Full UI/BFCache projection and all transient history states are not verified.

Page.navigatedWithinDocument.notes: Same-document history/hash notification; full navigation-type and ordering fidelity is not verified.

Page.reload.notes: Reloads canonical current document/history; ignoreCache and scriptToEvaluateOnLoad options are not implemented.

Page.removeScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument.notes: Removes a stored future-document script; unknown identifiers fail.

Page.setBypassCSP.notes: Changes canonical Page bypass policy used by supported script/resource/content-handler checks; full Chrome CSP/reporting is outside the implementation.

Page.setDocumentContent.notes: Writes selected frame document through normal parser/lifecycle; complete error/transition ordering is not verified.

Page.setFontFamilies.notes: Updates the Page generic font defaults used by the modeled environment; per-script family overrides and complete font selection behavior are not implemented. Generated/imported profile Contexts accept a proven no-op assignment but reject identity-changing emulation.

Page.setLifecycleEventsEnabled.notes: Per-session opt-in with current commit/load replay and shared-loader 500ms idle windows; not every Chrome lifecycle phase/timestamp is modeled.

Page.stopLoading.notes: Cancels active Page navigation/execution while retaining committed DOM.

Performance.disable.notes: Per-session subscription flags only; no complete corresponding event producers/replay. Performance timeDomain is not implemented.

Performance.enable.notes: Per-session subscription flags only; no complete corresponding event producers/replay. Performance timeDomain is not implemented.

Performance.getMetrics.notes: Timestamp only; Chrome metric set, counters, navigation timings and selected time domain are not implemented.

Runtime.addBinding.notes: Per-session payload subscriptions, current-context/future-world scoping, navigation persistence. Removal unsubscribes without removing the page callable.

Runtime.awaitPromise.notes: Promise waits yield the Page turn for commands/timers/input. Object previews and deep serialization are unsupported.

Runtime.bindingCalled.notes: Subscribed string payload/name/context from realm-local binding callables.

Runtime.callFunctionOn.notes: Realm/session-owned handles, by-value JSON, promises, unserializable arguments, exceptions and context/uniqueContextId selection. Deep serialization rejects. Previews, side-effect restrictions, REPL/CLI mode, userGesture and complete debugger options are not implemented. Unnamed evaluation origins and engine-direct function entry preserve author stacks and caller observations without debugger helper frames.

Runtime.consoleAPICalled.notes: Live remote-object arguments in emitting context; no historical replay or full async stacks.

Runtime.disable.notes: Live context/event subscription across default/isolated worlds; no historical console replay.

Runtime.discardConsoleEntries.notes: Releases console object group; no retained message buffer or replay model.

Runtime.enable.notes: Live context/event subscription across default/isolated worlds. Page-session initial command turns preserve arrival order; asynchronous commit/Promise waits yield rather than blocking later commands or independent sessions. No historical console replay.

Runtime.evaluate.notes: Realm/session-owned handles, by-value JSON, promises, unserializable arguments, exceptions and context/uniqueContextId selection. Deep serialization rejects. Previews, side-effect restrictions, REPL/CLI mode, userGesture and complete debugger options are not implemented. Unnamed evaluation origins and engine-direct function entry preserve author stacks and caller observations without debugger helper frames.

Runtime.exceptionThrown.notes: Asynchronous page errors in current context. Full exception object/stack/location fidelity and every task/promise source are incomplete.

Runtime.executionContextCreated.notes: Default/isolated frame context creation/teardown. Complete ordering/unique-id fields across all transitions are not verified.

Runtime.executionContextDestroyed.notes: Default/isolated frame context creation/teardown. Complete ordering/unique-id fields across all transitions are not verified.

Runtime.executionContextsCleared.notes: Default/isolated frame context creation/teardown. Complete ordering/unique-id fields across all transitions are not verified.

Runtime.getProperties.notes: Own/inherited descriptors, accessor filtering and live values without invoking getters. V8 private/internal slots and previews are incomplete.

Runtime.releaseObject.notes: Releases session-owned handles/groups while preserving page object identity and state.

Runtime.releaseObjectGroup.notes: Releases session-owned handles/groups while preserving page object identity and state.

Runtime.removeBinding.notes: Per-session payload subscriptions, current-context/future-world scoping, navigation persistence. Removal unsubscribes without removing the page callable.

Runtime.runIfWaitingForDebugger.notes: Resumes navigation queued by start-paused Target attachment; no Debugger-domain breakpoints.

Security.disable.notes: Per-session subscription flags only; no complete corresponding event producers/replay. Performance timeDomain is not implemented.

Security.enable.notes: Per-session subscription flags only; no complete corresponding event producers/replay. Performance timeDomain is not implemented.

Security.setIgnoreCertificateErrors.notes: Actual certificate policy: browser-root subscription covers current/future Pages, page subscription affects its target; active requests combine with OR and detach restores remaining policy. Verified/unverified transport pools are separate; unknown injected transports reject enabling.

Storage.clearCookies.notes: Clears selected canonical cookie store; Storage resolves explicit/default BrowserContext.

Storage.getCookies.notes: Canonical cookies; Network URL/current-frame filtering and explicit Storage BrowserContext scoping. Detailed source/priority metadata and opaque partitions are incomplete.

Storage.setCookies.notes: Canonical expiry/security/SameSite/partition identity/scoped deletion; explicit Storage context. Opaque partitions reject. priority/sameParty/sourceScheme/sourcePort metadata and all invalid-cookie errors are incomplete.

Target.activateTarget.notes: Acknowledged for clients, but native window activation and foreground-tab switching are not modeled; activation semantics are unsupported.

Target.attachToBrowserTarget.notes: Independent sessions, object registries and request ID spaces for page/tab/browser targets.

Target.attachToTarget.notes: Independent sessions, object registries and request ID spaces for page/tab/browser targets.

Target.attachedToTarget.notes: Flattened/nested transport lifecycle and messages with independent IDs; no worker/OOPIF graph.

Target.closeTarget.notes: Closes a live target and cancels its tasks including synchronous JavaScript. Nested sessions emit leaf-before-parent detach notifications so clients release closed child Pages.

Target.createBrowserContext.notes: Independent storage/cookies/Pages and disposeOnDetach. Proxy settings and universal-network-access origins reject. An empty proxyBypassList without proxyServer is accepted as a no-op, matching framework Context construction.

Target.createTarget.notes: Independent Page in selected context with scheduled URL navigation. Window/position/background/hidden/begin-frame options are not modeled.

Target.detachFromTarget.notes: Session-ID routing and teardown; legacy targetId-only addressing is not supported.

Target.detachedFromTarget.notes: Flattened/nested transport lifecycle and messages with independent IDs; no worker/OOPIF graph. Nested sessions emit leaf-before-parent detach notifications so clients release closed child Pages.

Target.disposeBrowserContext.notes: Disposes the named context and all its Pages.

Target.getBrowserContexts.notes: Lists non-default contexts owned by this browser.

Target.getTargetInfo.notes: Live page/tab target projection and type filtering; workers/service-workers/prerender targets are absent.

Target.getTargets.notes: Live page/tab target projection and type filtering; workers/service-workers/prerender targets are absent.

Target.receivedMessageFromTarget.notes: Flattened/nested transport lifecycle and messages with independent IDs; no worker/OOPIF graph.

Target.sendMessageToTarget.notes: Session-ID routing and teardown; legacy targetId-only addressing is not supported.

Target.setAutoAttach.notes: Nested/flattened browser-tab-page attachment, type filters and start-paused navigation. No worker/OOPIF/prerender graph.

Target.setDiscoverTargets.notes: Per-session discovery/filter state and live page/tab create/change/destroy events; no worker targets.

Target.targetCreated.notes: Live page/tab creation, URL changes and teardown. Worker/prerender targets and complete target metadata are not modeled.

Target.targetDestroyed.notes: Live page/tab creation, URL changes and teardown. Worker/prerender targets and complete target metadata are not modeled.

Target.targetInfoChanged.notes: Live page/tab creation, URL changes and teardown. Worker/prerender targets and complete target metadata are not modeled.

WebMCP.disable.notes: Client subscription state only; no Audits issue engine or WebMCP model-context backend. Semantic support is not claimed.

WebMCP.enable.notes: Client subscription state only; no Audits issue engine or WebMCP model-context backend. Semantic support is not claimed.

Mimic.getMediaSources.notes: Private Context-scoped camera and microphone source discovery with opaque binding IDs and native backend diagnostics; enumeration does not open capture or grant web permissions.

Mimic.getMediaPresets.notes: Bundled physical-camera class catalog. Virtual inputs are capture sources only; named model equivalence is not claimed.

Mimic.validateMediaProfile.notes: Compiles deterministic complete physical-class or custom device catalogs and rejects incoherent modes/defaults, unknown controls and conflicting overrides. Native format availability is checked at capture startup, not metadata validation.

Mimic.setMediaProfile.notes: Atomic Context-owned catalog replacement; stable seeded auto selection, source/identity isolation and optional microphone grouping. Live or starting capture rejects replacement. CPU crop/scale, frame-rate reduction and optional coherent output noise; advanced native camera controls are unsupported.

Mimic.getMediaProfile.notes: Read-only resolved catalog snapshots and private backend failure diagnostics; native bindings never become web device identity.

Mimic.createContext.notes: Creates validated generated/imported environment contexts with optional canonical media configuration installed before creating Pages. Failed media configuration disposes the new Context. Existing profile token, proxy, resource policy and disposeOnDetach behavior are preserved.

Mimic.getCompatibilityMatrix.notes: Returns the complete pinned Chrome wire inventory and separately pinned SDK-owned Mimic extension shapes with authoritative semantic support declarations. Generated shapes and partial scopes never imply Chrome parity or complete semantic implementation.

CSS.enable.notes: Session-owned read-only CSS activation, requiring DOM.enable as in frozen Chrome 152. Enables canonical computed-style reads. Stylesheet inventory, font/stylesheet notifications, rule editing and matched-rule inspection are not implemented.

CSS.disable.notes: Idempotently disables the session-owned read-only CSS domain and rejects subsequent computed-style reads. No stylesheet or font observer is installed; their notifications remain unsupported.

CSS.getComputedStyleForNode.notes: Reads modeled standard properties and inherited custom properties through the canonical document-owner CSSOM, with CSS enable prerequisite, live mutation visibility and no author getter invocation. Existing CSSOM value boundaries apply; exact Blink property inventory/order and unsupported styling remain unverified.

Mimic.configureContext.notes: Atomically configures an existing empty framework-owned Context before Pages are created, preserving the real client Context object. Rejects live/initializing/closing Pages, retained uploads and capture workers; profile/proxy/resource/media validation failures leave the Context unchanged.

Mimic.cancelExecution.notes: Session command; current runtime behavior only. Exact lifecycle and diagnostic payload coverage is incomplete.

Mimic.captureSnapshot.notes: Static portable DOM/assets snapshot with base64 file bodies and capture timings. Snapshot errors and supported resource limitations remain visible; no rendering backend is implied.

Mimic.clearTrace.notes: Session command; current runtime behavior only. Exact lifecycle and diagnostic payload coverage is incomplete.

Mimic.exportProfile.notes: Current portable profile and runtime identity contract. Generation is limited to the installed Chrome 152 Windows behavior bundle; coherence and recipe validation remain authoritative.

Mimic.generateProfile.notes: Current portable profile and runtime identity contract. Generation is limited to the installed Chrome 152 Windows behavior bundle; coherence and recipe validation remain authoritative.

Mimic.getDiagnostics.notes: Session command; current runtime behavior only. Exact lifecycle and diagnostic payload coverage is incomplete.

Mimic.getProfile.notes: Canonical Context/Page environment profile projection and ordinary Page overrides. Generated/imported profile invariants and explicit mutability boundaries are enforced; no arbitrary profile override mechanism.

Mimic.getProfileSchema.notes: Canonical Context/Page environment profile projection and ordinary Page overrides. Generated/imported profile invariants and explicit mutability boundaries are enforced; no arbitrary profile override mechanism.

Mimic.getResourcePolicy.notes: Context-owned resource policy command. First-match rules, supported presets and budget statistics share the loader state. Nonzero wire-byte budgets and unmodeled loader work remain unsupported.

Mimic.getResourcePolicySchema.notes: Context-owned resource policy command. First-match rules, supported presets and budget statistics share the loader state. Nonzero wire-byte budgets and unmodeled loader work remain unsupported.

Mimic.getResourcePolicyStats.notes: Context-owned resource policy command. First-match rules, supported presets and budget statistics share the loader state. Nonzero wire-byte budgets and unmodeled loader work remain unsupported.

Mimic.getStatus.notes: Session Page trace/status observation; trace collection starts only after explicit activation. Payloads expose recorded runtime events and current execution state, not a full Chrome tracing engine.

Mimic.getTrace.notes: Session Page trace/status observation; trace collection starts only after explicit activation. Payloads expose recorded runtime events and current execution state, not a full Chrome tracing engine.

Mimic.getVersion.notes: Current portable profile and runtime identity contract. Generation is limited to the installed Chrome 152 Windows behavior bundle; coherence and recipe validation remain authoritative.

Mimic.importProfile.notes: Current portable profile and runtime identity contract. Generation is limited to the installed Chrome 152 Windows behavior bundle; coherence and recipe validation remain authoritative.

Mimic.pause.notes: Session command; current runtime behavior only. Exact lifecycle and diagnostic payload coverage is incomplete.

Mimic.resetProfileOverrides.notes: Canonical Context/Page environment profile projection and ordinary Page overrides. Generated/imported profile invariants and explicit mutability boundaries are enforced; no arbitrary profile override mechanism.

Mimic.resume.notes: Session command; current runtime behavior only. Exact lifecycle and diagnostic payload coverage is incomplete.

Mimic.setViewport.notes: Updates ordinary Page viewport through canonical environment validation. Generated/imported profile Contexts reject identity-changing overrides.

Mimic.startTrace.notes: Session Page trace/status observation; trace collection starts only after explicit activation. Payloads expose recorded runtime events and current execution state, not a full Chrome tracing engine.

Mimic.stopTrace.notes: Session Page trace/status observation; trace collection starts only after explicit activation. Payloads expose recorded runtime events and current execution state, not a full Chrome tracing engine.

Mimic.updateProfile.notes: Canonical Context/Page environment profile projection and ordinary Page overrides. Generated/imported profile invariants and explicit mutability boundaries are enforced; no arbitrary profile override mechanism.

Mimic.updateResourcePolicy.notes: Context-owned resource policy command. First-match rules, supported presets and budget statistics share the loader state. Nonzero wire-byte budgets and unmodeled loader work remain unsupported.

Mimic.validateResourcePolicy.notes: Context-owned resource policy command. First-match rules, supported presets and budget statistics share the loader state. Nonzero wire-byte budgets and unmodeled loader work remain unsupported.
